result.topic_en: Calculations on plane gas waves with a discontinuity (shock): the Riemann-invariant variables p, q, the jump conditions for mass and momentum across the shock, and the integration of the resulting equations by means of an integrating function φ(α) and an arbitrary function F(α).
result.transcription:
$4p = \log\rho + \frac{u}{a}$ \quad $\rho_1 = \alpha\alpha\rho_2$
$4q = \log\rho - \frac{u}{a}$
$\frac{\partial x}{\partial t} = u_1 + a\sqrt{\frac{\rho_2}{\rho_1}} = u_2 + a\sqrt{\frac{\rho_1}{\rho_2}}$
$-4p = 2\log\alpha + \alpha - \frac{1}{\alpha}$ [-...-]
$4q = 2\log\alpha - \alpha + \frac{1}{\alpha}$
$x - (u+a)t = f(p)$ \quad $x - (u_1 - a)t = g(q) = (x - (u_2 + a)t) + (u_2 - u_1 + 2a)t)$
$= f(p) + at(2 - \alpha + \frac{1}{\alpha})$
$(\frac{\partial x}{\partial t} - (u+a))\frac{\partial t}{\partial p} - 2at = f'(p)$
$a(\alpha - 1)\frac{\partial t}{\partial p} - 2at = f'(p)$

$-\frac{2\partial p}{\alpha - 1} = \frac{\alpha}{2(\alpha-1)}(\frac{2}{\alpha} + 1 + \frac{1}{\alpha\alpha})\partial\alpha$
$= \frac{1}{2}\frac{(\alpha+1)^2}{\alpha(\alpha-1)}\partial\alpha = \frac{1}{2}\partial\alpha(1 - \frac{1}{\alpha} + \frac{4}{\alpha-1})$
$-\int\frac{2\partial p}{\alpha-1} = \frac{1}{2}\alpha - \frac{1}{2}\log\alpha + 2\log(\alpha-1) = \log\varphi(\alpha)$ \quad $\frac{\varphi'(\alpha)}{\varphi(\alpha)} = \frac{1}{2}\frac{(\alpha+1)^2}{\alpha(\alpha-1)}$ \quad $\frac{\varphi'(\alpha)}{\varphi(\alpha)}\partial\alpha = -\frac{2\partial p}{\alpha-1}$ \quad $\varphi'(\alpha)\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial p} = -2\frac{\varphi(\alpha)}{\alpha-1}$
$\varphi(\alpha) = e^{\frac{1}{2}\alpha}\frac{(\alpha-1)^2}{\alpha^{\frac{1}{2}}}$

[-...-] $-2a\varphi(\alpha)t = \int f'(p)\varphi'(\alpha)\partial\alpha = f(p)\varphi'(\alpha)\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial p} - \int f(p)\, d(\varphi'(\alpha)\frac{\partial\alpha}{\partial p})$ {+$+ F(\alpha)$+} [-...-]
$2 f(p)\, d(\frac{\varphi(\alpha)}{\alpha-1}) =$ [-...-] $d F(\alpha)$ \quad $f(p) = F'(\alpha)\, e^{-\frac{1}{2}\alpha}\frac{\alpha^{\frac{3}{2}}}{1+\alpha\alpha}$

$2d\frac{\varphi(\alpha)}{\alpha-1} = 2d\, e^{\frac{1}{2}\alpha}(\alpha^{\frac{1}{2}} - \alpha^{-\frac{1}{2}}) = e^{\frac{1}{2}\alpha}(\alpha^{\frac{1}{2}} - \alpha^{-\frac{1}{2}} + \alpha^{-\frac{1}{2}} + \alpha^{-\frac{3}{2}})\partial\alpha$
$= e^{\frac{1}{2}\alpha}\frac{\alpha\alpha+1}{\alpha^{\frac{3}{2}}}d\alpha$

$-\frac{1}{2}\frac{\alpha\alpha+1}{(\alpha-1)\alpha}\partial\alpha = -\frac{1}{2}\partial\alpha + \frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial\alpha}{\alpha} - \frac{\partial\alpha}{\alpha-1}$

$-2a\varphi(\alpha)t = -F'(\alpha)\frac{(\alpha-1)\alpha}{\alpha\alpha+1} + F(\alpha)$
$\varphi(\alpha)f(p) = F'(\alpha)\frac{\alpha(\alpha-1)^2}{\alpha\alpha+1}$
$\varphi(\alpha)g(q) = F'(\alpha)(\frac{\alpha(\alpha-1)^2}{\alpha\alpha+1} + \frac{\alpha-1(1+2\alpha-\alpha\alpha)}{\alpha\alpha+1}) - \frac{1}{2}F(\alpha)\frac{1+2\alpha-\alpha\alpha}{\alpha}$
$= F'(\alpha)\frac{\alpha\alpha-1}{\alpha\alpha+1} - F(\alpha)\frac{1+2\alpha-\alpha\alpha}{2\alpha}$
